requirement_text.ISS-0343: Letflow.TenantProvisioning.BackfillTest fails intermittently under scripts/test_parallel.sh: 'relation tenant_*.event_type_registry does not exist'. Standalone (mix test test/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill_test.exs) it passes cleanly (4/4, confirmed by ORCH directly before dispatch) -- this is specific to parallel-partition execution. test/support/tenant_fixture.ex's provisioned_tenant!/1 calls Sandbox.mode(Letflow.Repo, :auto) globally (not per-connection), same class of risk as ISS-0329's parallel-isolation fix. Needs real diagnosis (reproduce under scripts/test_parallel.sh repeatedly, not just standalone) before any fix is designed.
